ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx 75%) across the central surface area; low-intensity dark pixels (approx 25%) concentrated along the trailing edges, distal tips, and central vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central region; dark pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and outer margins. A distinct vertical dark band bisects the lower central region. Discrete dark circular clusters are localized on the left and right white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse V-shaped depression dividing the lobes with a wide pixel angle and minimal bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys (serrations) compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outer margins sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of small, localized dark pixel clusters on the high-intensity white background: two distinct spots on the left mid-lobe and several smaller, less-defined clusters on the right lower lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct unaligned dark linear disruptions: one diagonal mark on the mid-left lobe and one near-vertical mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography; presence of parallel-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical dark pigment strip at the median base where the fluke meets the peduncle.
